title: Rav Hinak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Pesachim 101b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.101b.1-3): Rav Idi bar Avin said to Rav Chisda, “So we learned it in the baraita of the school of Rav Hinak — and some say, in the baraita of the school of Bar Hinak — as you say.”[^1]

notes.text: Chisda cites Rav Huna. Idi then addresses Chisda and gives two forms of the school’s name, Rav Hinak or Bar Hinak. [Heilprin’s Hinak entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1031&lang=en) also preserves both forms and leaves his period open.
